  1. TechNode · Sep 23, 2026 · Industry news

    ASEAN teams outpace global peers on AI observability adoption

    Organizations in Southeast Asia are adopting observability tools for artificial intelligence faster than global peers, with 66 percent of ASEAN respondents having deployed AI application observability compared with 47 percent globally, while 59 percent use AI-assisted troubleshooting.

    Why it matters ASEAN engineering teams lose a median 47 percent of their capacity to system disruptions, compared with 37 percent globally, indicating high-value adoption targets for AI-driven incident automation.

    Sep 26, 2026 edition

  2. New Relic · Jul 3, 2026 · Vendor release

    New Relic Announces Autopilot and Ground Truth for Agentic AI-First Operations

    On June 23, New Relic announced Autopilot and Ground Truth capabilities for agentic AI-first businesses. New Relic Autopilot is an automated SRE agent that analyzes incidents, identifies root causes, and scopes remediation with specialized tools for Kubernetes and Kafka troubleshooting. Ground Truth provides direct API access to New Relic's observability data substrate for custom AI agents including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and AWS DevOps Agent, enabling autonomous operations without dashboard logins.

    Jul 3, 2026 edition

  3. New Relic · Jun 29, 2026 · Vendor release

    New Relic Champions Reliable AI-Generated Code and AI Observability Solutions at New Relic Now 2026

    New Relic announced New Relic AI Coding Observability as open-source GA, extending production-grade monitoring into IDEs. Also unveiled New Relic for Startups program and roadmap for FedRAMP High/DoD Impact Level 4 authorizations. Key finding: 94% of leaders rate AI-generated code higher quality at review, but 78% report more incidents post-deployment.

    Jun 29, 2026 edition
